verdict.rationale: Docusaurus documents first-class support for Algolia DocSearch, which is free for developer documentation. However, search depends on an external Algolia service that requires meeting a checklist rather than shipping out of the box. The evidence does not describe typo tolerance, relevance ranking or speed. missing for 10: built-in out-of-the-box search with no external service signup, documented typo tolerance, documented relevance ranking, evidence of speed or whole-site coverage, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, readers get fast, typo-tolerant, relevance-ranked search over the whole docs site out of the box

citations.quote: Docusaurus provides first-class support for Algolia DocSearch.
The service is **free** for any developer documentation or technical blog: just make sure to read the [checklist]
Make it easy for your community to find what they need in your documentation. We proudly support Algolia documentation search.
